title: Uruguayan Skillet Pancetta
description: A savory and sweet dish from Uruguay, combining crispy pancetta with a rich velvety sauce.
instructions: Preheat the skillet over medium heat.
Cook the pancetta slices until crispy, flipping halfway through.
Remove the pancetta from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the sweet ingredients and cook until caramelized.
Add the velvety sauce to the skillet and stir to combine with the sweet ingredients.
Return the pancetta to the skillet and toss to coat with the velvety sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
